ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the circle $O$, the radius $OC$ is perpendicular to the chord $AB$ at $D$, point $E$ is on the circle $O$, $\angle E=22.5^\circ$, and $AB=2$. What is the length of the radius $OB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} By the problem statement, radius $OC$ is perpendicular to chord $AB$ at point $D$,\\
$\therefore \overset{\frown}{AC}=\overset{\frown}{BC}$,\\
$\therefore \angle E=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=22.5^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOD=45^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \triangle ODB$ is an isosceles right triangle,\\
$\because AB=2$,\\
$\therefore DB=OD=1$,\\
$\therefore OB=\sqrt{1^2+1^2}=\boxed{\sqrt{2}}$.
